content:
Alert: cart响应时间突增告警
Root cause types: redisUnavailable
Root cause entities: cart-64944cd445-8pbgx
Conclusion: 2026-04-23 10:59:37，cart pod cart-64944cd445-8pbgx 的 Redis 6379 端口被注入 NetworkChaos；到 2026-04-23 11:02:03，cart apm.service 的 avg_request_latency_seconds 升到 99.898973s、request_count 跌到 3 req/30s，同时 request-traces 直接抛出 `Can't access cart storage ... Wasn't able to connect to redis`。故障随后闭合到告警实体 cart::POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart，该 operation 在同一分钟的 avg_request_latency_seconds 升到 95.634930s、request_count 跌到 2 req/30s，因此 fault family 继续维持 F029-redisUnavailable。
Causal evidence: 2026-04-23 10:59:37，inject_runtime 把 F029 注入到 cart pod `cart-64944cd445-8pbgx`；到告警分钟 2026-04-23 11:02:03，承载在该 pod 上的 cart apm.service 已出现 `avg_request_latency_seconds=99.898973s`，较 clean baseline 均值 `0.004492s` 放大 `22236.93x`，同一分钟 `error_count=3`。Phase 7 的 request-traces 和 raw trace `e835000227c71c4ed8b9a41ac403e1aa` 又直接抛出 `Can't access cart storage ... Wasn't able to connect to redis`，因此这一步不是推测，而是 pod 级 Redis 不可达已经命中根因对象。 | 2026-04-23 11:02:03，cart apm.service 的 `request_count=3 req/30s`，较 clean baseline 均值 `68769.325 req/30s` 下降 `99.996%`；同一分钟 `avg_request_latency_seconds=99.898973s`，较基线 `0.004492s` 放大 `22236.93x`。这说明故障已经从注入 pod 扩散成整个 cart service 的真实业务退化，而不是旧 GT 那种 `cart -> cart` 的占位式传播。 | 2026-04-23 11:02:03，告警实体 `cart::POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart` 的 `avg_request_latency_seconds=95.634930s`，较 clean baseline 均值 `0.002853s` 放大 `33520.81x`；同一分钟 `request_count=2 req/30s`，较基线 `34425.675 req/30s` 下降 `99.994%`。同一条 alert detail 又明确回出 `event_id=81a0e5e9436e76322c15fd488cb20ff5`、`rule_name=cart响应时间突增告警`、`entity_id=7bb1b1512922edfdefac66f31c640a81`，所以 impact 末跳与当前 top-level alert anchor 完全闭合。

Symptoms: empty nginx configuration; no server block; default.conf empty
Root causes: An empty mounted frontend site can pass nginx -t while defining no server/listen block. Recreating the container keeps the empty host mount.

title: CrashLoopBackOff caused by invalid command, args, or image
content:
Scenario: crashloop
Symptoms: CrashLoopBackOff; executable file not found; exec permission denied; exit code 126 or 127
Root causes: invalid container command; bad args; wrong image tag; binary missing or not executable
CHECK [R] kubectl logs <pod> -n <ns> -c <container> --previous :: capture startup error
CHECK [R] kubectl get pod <pod> -n <ns> -o yaml :: inspect resolved image, command and args
CHECK [R] kubectl rollout history deployment/<name> -n <ns> :: compare failing revision with last healthy revision
FIX [W] correct image, command or args in source manifest and apply reviewed change :: approval=True
FIX [W] roll back to last healthy Deployment revision for rapid recovery :: approval=True
Rollback: kubectl rollout undo deployment/<name> -n <ns> --to-revision=<known-good>
Verify: rollout status succeeds; pod remains Ready; previous-log startup error absent; service health check passes
Safety: record current revision before change; never substitute an unverified mutable image tag
Escalate: the failing image or its entrypoint is not one you build or can pin: hand the pod spec and the previous-container log to the image owner
Public fault types: override:solution-k8s-crashloop-invalid-command
tags: CrashLoopBackOff invalid command exit 126 exit 127 image args

title: this stack: upstream-wrong-port fixed by write_config ; docker_restart edge-victim
content:
Incident on this stack (drill upstream-wrong-port)
Symptoms: health at injection / 200 /api/ 502
Root cause: The upstream container `edge-victim-app` runs nginx listening on port **8080** (default config), but the front-end `edge-victim` proxied `/api/` to `http://edge-victim-app:80/` — a port mismatch. nginx on the front end got `connect() refused` (111) because nothing was listening on port 80 in the app
Fixed by: write_config ; docker_restart edge-victim (3 of 3 verified runs)
